cards.name: Siemens, the Ohmechanic Conductor

effects.lua_implementation: AddLinkProcedure requires two Ohmen monsters and revive limit.

official_references.matched_structure: Standard Link procedure with material filtering.

effects.printed_clause: ATK becomes 0 with no Current Counters; effects unlock at 1/2/3+ counters.
effects.lua_implementation: A single-range EFFECT_SET_ATTACK condition and per-effect counter threshold conditions implement the framework.

effects.printed_clause: 1+: During your Main Phase, Special Summon an "Ohmen" from GY; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition at 1+ counters checks Necrovalley and zone availability, then Special Summons one Ohmen; key id.

official_references.matched_structure: Archetypal GY Special Summon operation with HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: 2+: Quick Effect, move a monster on this card controller's field that a co-linked monster points to; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Card-targeting free-chain effect at 2+ counters finds own monsters pointed to by any controlled co-linked monster, then uses MoveSequence to any free own Main Monster Zone.

official_references.matched_structure: Official co-linked monster movement using MoveSequence.

effects.issue: The official reference moves a named Knightmare within linked zones; the CCG wording/implementation allows any pointed own monster and any free Main Monster Zone, a custom combination with no exact analogue.

effects.printed_clause: 3+: remove all Current Counters, target an opponent monster, place it in a pointed Main Monster Zone and take control; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Quick Effect removes all counters from this card as cost, derives a co-linked free-zone mask, targets a control-changeable opponent monster, and takes control into the chosen zone.
effects.issue: No exact official effect combines all-counter cost, zone-specific placement, and control change.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed two unresolved custom-reference gaps, not demonstrated Lua defects: official scripts cover the component movement/control operations but not these exact combinations.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
